geo_source: OSM Costa Bravo centreline and footprints, Aruba DEM
ref_sources: North side of Costa Bravo between Diamante and Sero Callejón. Satellite of this block (https://www.google.com/maps/@12.599858,-70.043234,131m/data=!3m1!1e3, refs/places/noord/diamante-75/satellite.jpg) shows repeating red-tile gable bays facing Costa Bravo, with palms and parking bays in front. There is no Street View on this carriageway. The Diamante 75 listing front (https://remaxaruba.com/property/details/gold-coast-diamante-75, refs/places/noord/diamante-75/) is a strong yellow facade with white arched, pedimented door surrounds, curved wrought-iron balconies, and orange planters along a paver drive. Original geometry, no photos in the mesh.
frame: glb origin = footprint centroid (world x,z); glTF +X = world x, +Z = world z, Y up; generated by tools/nw_costa_bravo_west.py
